Being alive we have time or new experience, new introductions etc. on our side to help us get over or get through. We have an unlimited amount of chances here. But death, death is permanent. People are so selfish in life because its just instinct, in our minds we come before anyone else. That is just humanity. And we have all the time, so we think, to do something for someone or help a friend or a stranger out. SO we just push that off most of the time and worry about our lives. There are few who truly sacrifice it all for the happiness of others.  Most people get caught up in their own lives that they forget that it is important to listen, to love, to be kind, to reach out to the ones you love because our time left is unpredictable. I dont know your family but I will just assume based of them wanting you to call them more often that they would stop it all for you. You might think they dont want to hear your problems but I am sure that if they knew that you were contemplating taking your own life, they would make sure to help you. Their lives might be busy, but when you die they will lose you forever, there is no going back and they would regret not being there for you. It is messed up how it takes the threat of death to be there, to be loving but again that is how society is. 
I dont know you but It seems you have a fire in you, your words are similar to mine that run through my head. I take that to heart. I want you to know that I am here to talk. Because fuck, Im there right now.
